name: Push (Chest/Shoulders/Triceps)
focus: Incline Press, Overhead Press, Dips, Lateral Raises

name: Pull (Back/Biceps/Rear Delts)
focus: Pull-ups/Lat Pulldown, Rows, Face Pulls, Bicep Curls
notes: Control the eccentric. Squeeze the back.

name: Legs (Quads/Hams/Glutes/Calves)
focus: Squats/Hack Squats, RDLs, Leg Extensions, Leg Curls
notes: Heavy compound day. Tough on the CNS.

name: Upper Body (All Round)
focus: Chest Press, Row, Shoulder Press, Pulldown, Arms

name: Lower Body (All Round)
focus: Leg Press, Lunges, Glute Ham Raises, Calves

name: Active Recovery / Zone 2
focus: Brisk walking, light cycling, or stairmaster

name: Full Rest
focus: Stretching, mobility work, or complete rest
notes: Crucial for CNS recovery and muscle growth.
